from flask import Flask, Blueprint
import pytest

EXPECTED_SYMPTOM = {
    "exception_type": "KeyError",
    "message_regex": "endpoint",
    "description": "Blueprint registration with empty endpoint string raises KeyError",
    "target_symbols": ["flask.blueprints.Blueprint.add_url_rule"],
}

def test_reproduce_issue():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    bp = Blueprint('bp', __name__)
    bp.add_url_rule('/test', endpoint='')
    app.register_blueprint(bp)
